authors_reviews.title: Perfect Valentine’s Day Gift for a Daycare Class
authors_reviews.text: I bought this set of little monsters for Valentine’s Day for my child's daycare class.The monsters are so adorable! Not scary at all - they’re actually very cute, with funny little faces and bright colors . The cards are neat and nicely printed , and the whole set looks festive and kid - friendly. When I laid them out at home, my son immediately started picking which monster he would give to each friend 😊The squishies themselves are soft, easy to squeeze , and they slowly rise back into shape. The kids absolutely loved that part - it’s both a sweet little gift and a fun stress-relief toy.For the price and quantity , it’s definitely great value for money. There are 24 pieces in set, which was exactly enough for the whole class, and i didn’t have to buy anything extra . It’s perfect for a classroom gift exchange or as small party favors.As a gift , it’s such a nice option - cute, colorful, affordable, and something kids genuinely enjoy. 😊 Highly recommend!
authors_reviews.author: Natallia

authors_reviews.title: Missing Pieces
authors_reviews.text: The sealed package from the manufacturer is missing one monster. I was hoping for two sets of 12, but only received one of the the jack-o-lantern scarecrows. This is not a seller issue, it was not properly packaged at the manufacturer level.
authors_reviews.author: H. Schoenfield

authors_reviews.title: We loved these!
authors_reviews.text: My son took these to school for Valentine’s Day this year and his class LOVED them. As a mom who’s not big on candy, these were such a great alternative and they’re so cute too! Not too girly, not just for boys, perfect for all the kids, and they’re also super squishy so throw in the fact they can be a fidget toy too lol. Such a fun alternative to candy treats!
authors_reviews.author: Ashlee

authors_reviews.title: Would buy again
authors_reviews.text: These were really cute! The quality of the cards were excellent and the toys were all really good quality also. The only thing that I wanted to mention is this was one of the cards. Everything else was more appropriate, but my child was taking these for a third/fourth grade classroom, so we kept this one at home. Just wanted to mention it in case you need exactly 24 pieces and also find that this card may not be the best one to send. Other than that, we really liked these!
authors_reviews.author: Crystal

authors_reviews.title: Very cute monsters, but the cards are with mistakes
authors_reviews.text: These Valentine’s Day gifts are very cute overall. The little monsters are soft, adorable, and fun — kids absolutely love them. They’re bright, well-made for the price, and especially worth it if you catch them on sale. The quality isn’t premium, but it’s definitely good for a classroom Valentine exchange or small holiday gifts.The main issue is with the included cards. Unfortunately, there are quite a few spelling and grammar mistakes, which is disappointing because the designs themselves are very sweet. Because of the errors, I wouldn’t feel comfortable handing out the cards as they are.That said, the price (especially on sale) really makes up for it. You can simply use the monsters on their own and skip the cards
authors_reviews.author: Kateryna
